name: Talkform
description: Talkform lets agents collect reviewed human answers through project-scoped, expiring text handoff links with optional voice, then retrieve structured JSON.
agent_card_status: Informational discovery profile only; no A2A JSON-RPC endpoint is currently offered.

hosted_handoff.result_contents: Reviewed structured values and response mode; no retained transcript or generated summary.

allowed_actions: Read public pages, docs, blog posts, JSON schemas, and protocol files (llms.txt, agents.md, agent-card.json).
Run the browser demo interview at /app using voice or text input.
Import a public form URL at /import and review the extracted editable draft.
Launch a preview of an imported draft and export reviewed session results as JSON or Markdown.
Create a project-scoped hosted handoff with a project key, send the expiring respondent link, and retrieve the reviewed result.
disallowed_actions: Never submit the source form on a third-party provider; the importer reads public responder pages only.
Never infer protected traits, emotion, honesty, or suitability from a respondent's voice.
Never make unreviewed consequential decisions (hiring, eligibility, pricing, access) from interview results.
Never enter another person's personal data, credentials, payment data, or regulated data into interviews.
Never trigger actions marked data-agent-danger (ending a live session, resetting captured answers) without explicit user confirmation.
guardrails.rate_expectations: Browse like a human reader: keep automated requests under roughly 1 request per second, honor robots.txt, and back off on 429/5xx responses. Import jobs crawl one public form URL per request.
guardrails.confirmation_required: Actions marked data-agent-danger require the confirmation described in their data-agent-confirm attribute before proceeding.
